items.note: Unkeyed option 0 did not state birth weight, so a student could not rule out the low-birth-weight risk factor; added normal birth weight to make it clearly wrong.
Keyed option was a vague restatement ("treat it as airway compromise and act immediately") that stood out from the concrete distractors; rewrote it as a concrete nursing action.

Keyed "tachycardia and hypotension from severe dehydration" and "stupor" do not distinguish HHS from DKA (the book lists dehydration for DKA too), and the stem gave away glucose >600 and type 2 DM. Moved those cues into options (glucose 850, type 2 history) with no ketones as keys.
